title: Процесс или Результат? (Сортировка)
description: Отнеси предложения к Past Perfect (Результат/Количество) или Past Perfect Continuous (Процесс/Длительность).

items.verb: I had downloaded 5 apps by 5 PM.
I had been downloading this app for an hour when the computer crashed.
She had written three emails before the boss came.
She had been writing emails all morning when her computer broke.
They had played 2 matches before it rained.
They had been playing for 2 hours when it started to rain.
He had been reading this book for a week before he returned it.
He had read 50 pages by 5 PM.
